title: Function card
responsibility: Shows a linked helper invocation or model name with a smaller Used In row linking up to three consumers.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.row
inputs.description: The helper or model at the viewed revision, including its display name, optional sample arguments and up to three direct consumer links.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.nav
inputs.description: Navigation retaining branch and commit for helper, model and consumer links.

outputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard
outputs.description: A clickable helper invocation or model name and smaller Used In row. Models open their overview; helpers open their callable contract. Both retain revision scope and identical card styling.
